scope: Session labeling tool built and exercised on pilot_s01 drafts; human review of pilot_s01 not done yet, so nothing has been exported or trained.

design.inputs: dataset/raw_sessions/<session>/ plus <session>.manifest.json; every raw image is re-hashed before use
design.drafts: default pipeline V5 (confidence 0.15) gives boxes and draft classes; MobileSAM outlines each box; masks cleaned (largest region, holes filled); SAM outline is the default only when it overlaps the model mask with IoU >= 0.5
design.review: local page on 127.0.0.1 (foreign Host/Origin refused); each outlined instance needs a class or 'not a block'; reviewers can draw a box to add a missed block (MobileSAM outline); decisions saved per image with mask and image hashes
design.export: only approved images; not-a-block and unusable images excluded; reviewed masks converted with prepare_real_training.mask_polygon round-trip check; output is the frozen-suite layout read by run_experiment.py (manifest.jsonl with session group_id, freeze.json) plus data.yaml; refuses pending images unless asked, changed raw images, changed masks and nonempty output

fixed_during_build: unknown image in a review request crashed the server connection; now rejected with 400 and a direct check

pilot_s01_drafts.visual_check: SAM outlines tight on coloured blocks; V5 draft classes often wrong on this camera (e.g. tetrahedron as cone, grey cube as cylinder); the remote control in frames 13-40 is drafted as a block; most white cubes and two green spheres are missed and need manual boxes

revision_outline_fix.cause: default rule fell back to the model outline when SAM and model disagreed (IoU < 0.5), but in those cases the model outline was the wrong one: it merged neighbours (frames 39/40 tetrahedron + cone) or dropped faces
revision_outline_fix.fix: SAM is the default when it fits its prompt box (>= 90% of the outline inside the 10%-padded box and area >= 15% of the box); otherwise the model outline. Reviewers can now redraw an outline from a tighter box (MobileSAM) or trace it by clicking corners; each becomes an extra outline option, earlier mask files are never overwritten
revision_outline_fix.browser_check: review page loads, outline tools present, no console errors

not_done: Export and smoke training on yhj
